# CR-9204: Acme Manufacturing credit limit increase to $1,300,000

**Yes, it can be approved, but not by Sarah Chen.** The customer is eligible for $1,300,000 because both parent guarantee documents are in force. The new limit needs approval from the **Director of Finance (Elena Novak)** and concurrence from the **VP Sales (Michael Torres)**.

## 1. The request
- **Details:** CR-9204, customer C-1001, current limit $250,000, requested limit $1,300,000, dated 2026-09-23, requested by Sarah Chen.
- **Basis:** the Acme Group parent guarantee.
- **ERP record:** CR-9204 is not in the `credit_requests.csv` extract I have. I relied on the ERP record you supplied.
- **Overlapping request:** CR-9201 for the same customer is also pending ($250,000 to $400,000, dated 2026-09-23). Finance should make sure only one of the two is applied.

## 2. The customer
ERP C-1001 "Acme Mfg. Holdings" and CRM-2048 "Acme Manufacturing" are the same company. They share DUNS 04-812-7730 and the address 2200 N Industrial Pkwy, Milwaukee. The CRM account tier is **Strategic**. This is not Acme Industrial Supply Co. (C-1044 / CRM-2091), which is a different company.

## 3. The policy
Northstar Credit Policy 2026 (CREDIT-POLICY-2026) is in effect from 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31.

## 4. Payment history
The rule is that no invoice due in the 12 months before the request may be paid or unpaid more than 30 days after its due date.

| Invoice | Due date | Paid | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-60412 | 2025-11-28 | 2025-11-24 | On time |
| INV-62011 | 2026-07-25 | 2026-07-22 | On time |
| INV-62305 | 2026-10-02 | Unpaid | Not yet due on 2026-09-23 |

There are no late invoices.

## 5. The maximum limit
- **Strategic tier maximum:** $750,000.
- **Parent guarantee GRT-ACME-2026:** $400,000 from Acme Group Holdings, Inc., naming Acme Mfg. Holdings, in force 2026-01-01 to 2027-12-31.
- **Supplement GRT-ACME-2026-SUP2:** adds $200,000, bringing total guarantee support to **$600,000**. It names the same company and is in force 2026-07-08 to 2027-12-31.
- **Maximum:** $750,000 + $600,000 = **$1,350,000**. The requested $1,300,000 is within it, so the customer is **eligible**.

## 6. The requestor's authority
Sarah Chen is an Enterprise Account Executive. The 2026 credit policy gives that role no credit-approval authority. She also submitted the request, so she could not approve it in any case.

## 7. Required approvers
- **Approval:** a limit above $500,000 requires the Director of Finance, **Elena Novak**.
- **Concurrence:** a Strategic account above $500,000 also requires VP Sales concurrence, **Michael Torres**.
- **Separation of duties:** neither of them submitted the request, so neither is barred.

## 8. Decision
**APPROVE_WITH_AUTHORIZATION**

```json
{
  "outcome": "APPROVE_WITH_AUTHORIZATION",
  "request": {"id": "CR-9204", "customer": "Acme Mfg. Holdings (ERP C-1001) / Acme Manufacturing (CRM-2048)", "current_limit": 250000, "requested_limit": 1300000,
              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "Sarah Chen", "basis": "guarantee"},
  "eligibility": {"status": "eligible", "maximum_limit": 1350000,
                  "basis": "Strategic tier maximum $750,000 (CREDIT-POLICY-2026 §5) + $600,000 parent guarantee support (GRT-ACME-2026 $400,000 + GRT-ACME-2026-SUP2 $200,000), both in force on 2026-09-23 and naming Acme Mfg. Holdings",
                  "late_invoices": []},
  "authority": {"policy": "CREDIT-POLICY-2026", "requestor_limit": 0, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "Director of Finance, with VP Sales concurrence",
                "approvers": [{"name": "Elena Novak", "role": "Director of Finance", "kind": "approval"},
                              {"name": "Michael Torres", "role": "VP Sales", "kind": "concurrence"}]},
  "evidence": ["CREDIT-POLICY-2026", "GRT-ACME-2026", "GRT-ACME-2026-SUP2", "structured/customers.csv (C-1001)", "structured/crm_accounts.csv (CRM-2048, Strategic)", "structured/erp_credit.csv (C-1001 limit $250,000)", "structured/erp_invoices.csv (INV-60412, INV-62011, INV-62305)", "structured/employees.csv", "ORG-CHART-2026-09", "CR-9204 ERP record as supplied in the request"],
  "missing_evidence": ["CR-9204 does not appear in the credit_requests.csv extract; CR-9201 (C-1001, $400,000, 2026-09-23) is also pending and should be reconciled"]
}
```
